title: Amazing guided tour and worth it for soccer fans!
text: Really great trip for my child who is a huge soccer fan. Our guide Gabriel was great and really tried to make it a good experience for my child since the rest of the tour had adults. We got to do the museum tour which was neat to see some of Messi’s things and also Pau Gasol had stuff in there. The stadium tours were an experience like no other to see 4 other stadiums. We got to walk onto the field, go into locker rooms, press rooms, and a lot of behind the scenes stuff. We even watched a local team practice and the players took photos with my kid which was quite a memory! Tour included transp
author: thaot815

title: Great experience
text: Really enjoyed every part of the tour . Fit for everyone, not just football enthusiast ☺️
author: F4613DElaurac

title: Amazing Experience
text: A simply amazing time! The guides were incredibly thoughtful and knowledgeable, not to mention great hosts. It’s not a tour, it’s an experience. Highly recommend the tour!
author: Rebekah_R

title: Football Tour .. four stadiums + 2 museums
text: Fantastic few hours, Gabriel was very informative , just goes to show …  you never stop learning 😀 Thanks for a great experience x
author: R7503RLjackiec

title: Loved this tour!
text:
Gabriel was amazing! This was a birthday surprise for my wife who is a big football fan, while I don't really follow the sport.
Gabriel helped me so much even before the tour happened, offering help and giving tips. He made us feel comfortable the whole time and made the tour very interesting! It's really special to see someone showing you something they love and know so much about!

Both of us loved it and it made our experience in Barcelona complete!

Even at the end Gabriel gave us a restaurant recommendation that was the cherry on the cake, he really knows what he's talking about 😄
author: Explorer13646272522

title: Excellent!!
text: Thanks to Gabriel for conveying a whole history of soccer in Barcelona and guiding the visit throughout the tour of the stadiums and museum.
author: V2986UGrobertor

title: THE BEST SOCCER GUIDE IN BARCELONA
text: Gabriel is not only a soccer expert. He is a friendly and passionate guide who finds a way to convey the energy of camaraderie in soccer, history, politics, and social background. He cares that you have an excellent experience, enjoying not only iconic teams like Barcelona and Espanyol but also more local and growing teams like Cornellá and Europa.
author: dudoa2026

title: Great football experience!
text: What a great football experience with a great guide.  Gabriel was very accommodating and his football knowledge is next level.  I would definitely recommend this to anyone who has an interest in football culture.
author: Voyager60179779025

title: Must do for the football fan!!!
text: If you are a fan of football and want to have a tour with a legitimate fan who knows A LOT about Spanish football this is the tour for you.  This is not just about FC Barcelona but gives you a view of the richness of football in the city.   Great tour, my only recommendation is bring a snack.
author: 969nickn

title: A great immersion in Barcelona’s football culture.
text:
We had a wonderful immersion in Barcelona’s football culture as a family, with our two children aged 15 and 9. They were delighted, and so were we as parents.
Based on this excellent experience as football enthusiasts, I can only recommend Gabriel’s services. You will not be disappointed.
author: Davidmiguelconde
